items.description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.

items.description_en: A local-first AI design studio that uses coding agents to create prototypes, decks, images, and videos with export-ready files for production workflows.

items.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. 42 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.

items.description_en: An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi that creates polished editorial diagrams for websites, technical documents, presentations, and branded content.

items.description: This repository contains the source code for the paper First Order Motion Model for Image Animation
items.description_zh: 通过迁移驱动视频中的关键点运动，让单张人脸、人体或物体图像生成自然动画，适合动作重定向与视频编辑研究。
items.description_en: Animates a source image by transferring motion from a driving video, making it useful for motion retargeting, face animation, and video editing research.

items.description: Fullstack app framework for web, desktop, and mobile.
items.description_zh: Dioxus 是基于 Rust 的全栈应用框架，帮助开发者用一套代码构建 Web、桌面和移动应用，适合需要跨平台交付与快速热重载的项目。
items.description_en: Dioxus is a Rust fullstack app framework for building web, desktop, and mobile applications from one codebase, suited to cross-platform projects needing fast iteration and native access.

items.description: Programmatic video for coding agents — HTML to video on your laptop. Turn HTML, CSS & data into real MP4s with pluggable render engines, 21 templates, AI soundtrack. Apache-2.0, no per-render fees. An official project by the Open Design team.
items.description_zh: 将 HTML、CSS 与数据在本地程序化渲染为 MP4 视频，适合开发者和编程智能体批量制作模板化内容。
items.description_en: Locally turns HTML, CSS, and data into MP4 videos, ideal for developers and coding agents creating automated, template-based content.

items.description: Agent skill: convert Chinese story copy or ordered images into a hand-drawn diary-comic animation (silent MP4 picture track).
items.description_zh: 将中文故事文案或有序图片自动制作成手绘日记漫画风格的无声 MP4 动画，适合故事短片与社媒内容创作。

items.description: Pure TypeScript media toolkit for reading, writing, and converting video and audio files, directly in the browser.
items.description_zh: 纯 TypeScript 的高性能媒体工具包，适合在浏览器及 JavaScript 运行时中读写、编解码和转换音视频文件。
items.description_en: A high-performance TypeScript toolkit for reading, encoding, decoding, and converting audio and video in browsers and JavaScript runtimes.

items.description: A neural network that transforms a design mock-up into a static website.
